thread:
maria_support: Hi — escalating from customer_jane (Dedicated tenant). They're seeing SAML logins fail after an IdP cert rotation + SCIM bulk provisioning 422s. Also report audit events for these actions are not appearing in the audit stream, and when they tried to export key material for debug we see a KMS/HSM error. Errors: `SAML: invalid assertion - conditions not yet valid` and `SCIM Bulk: entry 34 -> 422 Unprocessable Entity` and `KMS: wrap_key failed: HSM_TIMEOUT`.

aj_security: Thanks, Maria. Can you paste the raw SAML response (redact attributes) and a snippet of the HSM error log? Also need the tenant id and whether they use our managed KMS or their HSM.

maria_support: Tenant: tenant-acme-42. They use our managed KMS but requested HSM-wrapped exports for compliance. I asked customer_jane for the SAML raw response and they pasted this (redacted):

customer_jane: 
```
<samlp:Response IssueInstant=\"2025-10-03T15:02:10Z\" ...>
  <saml:Conditions NotBefore=\"2025-10-03T15:07:10Z\" NotOnOrAfter=\"2025-10-03T16:07:10Z\"> ...</saml:Conditions>
</samlp:Response>
```

maria_support: So NotBefore is 5 minutes in the future vs the Response IssueInstant -> looks like IdP clock ahead. That matches `conditions not yet valid`.

aj_security: Yep — classic clock skew. Two action items: (1) Ask IdP to sync NTP, (2) we can temporarily widen server allowed skew for this tenant (config flag) while they fix IdP. I'll need the IdP entityID and metadata.

kevin_infra: On the HSM/KMS side: I pulled logs for tenant-acme-42 around 15:10Z. We see repeated wrap_key attempts timing out due to HSM pool saturating during the SCIM bulk job:
```
2025-10-03T15:09:07Z ERROR kms.wrap_key tenant=tenant-acme-42 req=abc123 status=timeout hsm_id=hsm-7
2025-10-03T15:09:08Z WARN  hsm.pool saturation=0.98 active=24 queued=82
2025-10-03T15:09:09Z INFO  scim.bulk id=job-998 entries=500 duration=00:02:37
```

devon_devex: SCIM client is doing a bulk with 500 entries in a single request. We recommend batching at 50-100 to avoid HSM/TLS handshakes amplifying latency. Also our SCIM handler currently does synchronous signing per entry which hits KMS for each user in a bulk. We should queue signing and do a single batch signature or sign payloads in-process when allowed.

maria_support: Customer says provisioning started failing at ~15:08 and they saw retries which spiked tokens and billing.

lucy_billing: I can see a usage spike for tenant-acme-42 from 15:08-15:12: ~9x normal KMS ops and ~6x token calls for the API (retries). I'm putting a temporary cap on retry billing and flagging a grace credit while we triage.

aj_security: For audit logs: I checked the audit ingestion pipeline — we have the SCIM and SAML events but some audit records were dropped because our audit forwarder hit the HSM when signing the audit bundle and timed out (same saturation). So it looks like root cause is HSM saturation from large SCIM bulk plus IdP causing rapid retries. That's why some audit events are missing.

maria_support: Repro steps for infra to run locally:
```
# replicate with tenant creds
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/scim/Bulk -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d @bulk-500.json
# watch KMS wrap attempts in infra logs
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=kms --tail=200 | grep tenant-acme-42
```

kevin_infra: I'll run a repro on a staging hsm pool with batch size 500. Quick mitigation for production: lower SCIM bulk concurrency on the tenant to 25 and enable async_signing feature flag for them.

devon_devex: I'll draft a short doc for customers on SCIM best practices (recommended batch sizes, retry backoff, and guidance for HSM-backed tenants).

aj_security: Short-term plan:
- ask IdP to NTP sync (maria to send template)
- kevin to throttle SCIM bulk concurrency and enable async_signing for tenant-acme-42
- lucy to apply billing grace/limit and follow up with finance
- devon to publish SCIM guidance and add a FAQ about SAML clock skew
- I will open a ticket to add tenant-level skew tolerance config and a longer-term fix to avoid per-entry KMS hits on bulk ops.

maria_support: Sent IdP email template to customer_jane, +cc @aj_security. Customer confirms they pushed NTP update to IdP.

hsm_bot: NOTICE: hsm-7 pool CPU usage degraded at 2025-10-03T15:11:44Z, recovered at 2025-10-03T15:18:02Z. Active sessions peaked at 28, queued peaked at 96.

kevin_infra: I applied the tenant throttle (concurrency=25) and enabled async_signing for tenant-acme-42 at 15:20Z. Retried the customer's bulk job with 250 entries -> completed, no KMS timeouts.

customer_jane: Confirmed provisioning resumed. Audit events for the failed window show up now after replay. Thanks for the quick help! :thumbsup:

aj_security: Closing loop: will file the SR for skew-tolerance feature and follow up on audit-forwarder graceful degradation (avoid dropping events when HSM busy).

lucy_billing: Billing credit applied for the spike window. I'll email customer with details and link to the mitigation doc when devon posts it.

maria_support: Great. Marking as resolved for support case #45218. If anything new pops up reopen. :eyes:
